former_edge.description: Current curated formal reaction assignment through ENZRXN-16329. CNB-1 CnbE has a native hydratase activity assignment. Its complete protein comment reports coexpression of cnbE and cnbF in E. coli and a chlorinated substrate conversion; neither protein was purified. Exact unchlorinated catalysis is excluded from the formal-reaction graph. The historical assay preparation does not independently establish every stated enol geometry or absolute configuration.

disposition: Excluded from the selected graph. The native activity pointer is preserved as a database assignment through ENZRXN-16329, but the complete protein comment reports coexpression of cnbEF and a chlorinated conversion only. This does not support exact unchlorinated RHEA:22582 catalysis.
